title: The Ash Sea
text: A sea of ash stretches ahead, grey and soft and endless, with long shapes moving under its surface. A devil sits on the shore in a boat of black bone, picking its teeth. It offers you passage. It does not mention the fare.

options.label: Take the devil's boat, and do not ask the fare.

outcomes.text: A fast, smooth crossing over the grey. The fare comes later, and it comes for everyone.
Something under the ash takes an interest, and the ash is hot, very hot, all the way down.

options.label: The shrewdest haggles over the fare.

outcomes.text: A fair price, paid in coin. The devil looks almost offended.
The devil haggles better. It always does.
